channel.title: Arix ALIMAGNIDOKPO — AI & NLP Engineer, Founder of AIDA
channel.description: Arix ALIMAGNIDOKPO — AI & NLP engineer in Cotonou, Benin. Founder and CEO of AIDA. AI Developer and Project Lead at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Benin, working on low-resource language NLP and responsible AI.

item.title: What a year of shipping AI inside a ministry actually taught me
item.description: Retrieval-augmented generation is easy to demo and hard to deploy in an institution. Notes from building a document platform for Benin’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

item.title: The digital divide in Africa is a language divide
item.description: Connectivity is not the bottleneck any more. The bottleneck is that the machine does not speak Fon — and the person in front of it does not speak French.
